research:
I've finished the research and am writing up the report. Everything below uses only sources dated on or before 2026-08-24.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no URL. The outcome depends on official US and Iranian government and military statements (for example, CENTCOM press releases) and a consensus of credible reporting.
- 2026-08-24: I could not load the CENTCOM releases page or Polymarket directly because the proxy refused the connection. Search results did not show any CENTCOM release about a strike on Iranian territory dated between July 30 and August 24. One CENTCOM index listing showed "Aug. 15" next to a strike release, but the article itself carries a later date, so I treat that index date as wrong. [CENTCOM releases](https://www.centcom.mil/MEDIA/PUBLIC-RELEASES/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The last US strike on Iran I could confirm was on the evening of 2026-07-29 (US Eastern time). As of August 24, about 25 days had passed with no confirmed US strike, but there is no formal ceasefire in force.
- 2026-07-29: CENTCOM struck dozens of IRGC targets in Iran between 8 and 10 pm EDT. This was retaliation for an attempted Iranian ballistic-missile attack on US forces in Jordan. [Washington Examiner](https://washingtonexaminer.com/policy/defense/4668554/us-strikes-iran-jordan-attack-retaliation), [WJCT/NPR](https://news.wjct.org/2026-07-30/u-s-launches-heavy-strikes-on-iran-after-attack-on-base-in-jordan)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-24: The US launched "Operation Economic Outcast," a sanctions campaign. Treasury Secretary Bessent said it would go after all of Iran's revenue sources, including oil. This is economic pressure, not military action. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/24/trump-administration-announces-global-economic-war-on-iran)
- 2026-08-21: Critical Threats (ISW) says the failed memorandum of understanding (MoU) has weakened Iran's pro-concession camp relative to hardliners such as IRGC commander Vahidi. President Pezeshkian said the war must end at some point, and Iran's central bank governor said on 08-19 that oil exports had nearly stopped. [Critical Threats](https://www.criticalthreats.org/analysis/iran-update-august-21-2026)
- 2026-08-18/19: Trump posted a map labeling the Strait of Hormuz "NEW U.S. Territory." He said the naval blockade "remains in full force" and that "no talks... ongoing, or scheduled" with Iran, which contradicted Kushner's comment a day earlier about "very positive" conversations. [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/08/trump-says-no-iran-talks-planned-claims-hormuz-new-us-territory), [Khaleej Times](https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/mena/trump-strait-of-hormuz-us-territory-august-19-2026)
- 2026-08-17: The 60-day MoU deadline passed without a deal. Trump said he would not extend it ("I'm not in a hurry") and threatened to bomb Oman if it "gets in the way." Trump also claimed a direct backchannel with the IRGC, which the IRGC denied. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/17/us-iran-war-trump-hormuz.html), [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/17/world/live-news/iran-war-trump), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/17/us-iran-memorandum-of-understanding-expires-how-and-why-it-fell-apart)
- 2026-08-04: Iran's military said it is ready to resume war if negotiations fail and is building up its forces during the pause. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/4/maximum-use-iran-boosts-military-strength-during-ceasefire-with-us)
- Around 2026-08-01/02: Trump said he would halt planned new attacks pending talks. [CBS](https://cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-trump-us-diplomacy-oil-prices-strait-of-hormuz)
- 2026-07-27: Trump said the US had halted strikes at Iran's request and warned they would resume without a deal. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/27/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)

## 4. Base rates
- The war began on 2026-02-28. The April ceasefire saw violations, for example US strikes on 2026-05-07. The June MoU arrangement broke down on 07-08, when strikes resumed. CENTCOM then struck Iran on 12 consecutive nights up to about 07-22, and again on 07-29. Trump has repeatedly announced pauses that did not hold. [Wikipedia: May 7 strikes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/7_May_2026_United_States_strikes_on_Iran), [Wikipedia: ceasefire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Iran_war_ceasefire), [PBS](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/trump-frequently-announces-hes-halting-strikes-in-iran-but-they-keep-happening)
- Pattern: most US strikes since April have been retaliation for Iranian attacks on US forces or shipping, such as the Jordan attacks and the Hormuz incidents. The roughly 25-day gap from July 30 to August 24 is the longest quiet stretch I found since the June MoU. The remaining window (about Aug 24 to 31) is roughly 7 days.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I could not get a live Polymarket price for this market.
- An undated Polymarket snapshot of the "US-Iran ceasefire continues through...?" market showed Aug 31 at 99%, Sep 15 at 90%, Sep 30 at 79% and Oct 31 at 70%. Its context mentioned the August 18 Hormuz map. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/us-ceasefire-against-iran-continues-throughptptpt)
- The related "effective ceasefire by Aug 31" market (a 2-week pause) was at about 57.5% on 07-16, about 63.5% on 07-26 and about 70% on 07-25. It fell to 48% around 08-01 and later rose to the mid-90s. [Lines](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/world/us-x-iran-effective-ceasfire-byptptpt-2-week-pause-20260715194822042), [CryptoSlate](https://cryptoslate.com/predictions/market/us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-date/), [CoinGape](https://coingape.com/prediction-markets/will-us-x-iran-have-an-effective-ceasefire-by-august-31/), [Cryptorank](https://cryptorank.io/news/feed/d530f-polymarket-us-iran-ceasefire-odds-august)
- I found no Kalshi, Manifold or expert forecasts.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The US naval blockade and the Hormuz standoff continue. Mine-clearing or blockade enforcement could lead to clashes, and IRGC attacks on shipping or US troops have been the usual trigger for US retaliation.
- "Operation Economic Outcast" sanctions are being rolled out, and Iran may respond.
- Talks are uncertain: Trump says none are scheduled, while Kushner described "active conversations."
- Watch for any Trump deadline or ultimatum, attacks by Iran's proxies (Iraqi militias, Houthis) on US forces, and CENTCOM statements.
- The market's dispute clause can keep it open for up to 3 extra days after a contested incident.
